correctness.rationale: For R=triangular(K,M,L), diagonal products of k independent uniform factors have target masses h_Q,k and h_T,k. The off-diagonal coordinate is sum_j (a_1...a_{j-1}) b_j (c_{j+1}...c_k). Conditional on scalar diagonals, any nonzero coefficient is a bijective additive map of M, forcing uniform output. All coefficients vanish exactly when first a-zero occurs strictly before last c-zero, an event of probability E_k=(QT)^-1 sum_{1<=i<j<=k}t_Q^(i-1)t_T^(k-j), necessarily both diagonal targets zero. This proves the exact all-k all-target formula. In F4⊕F4 normal/Frobenius right actions, centers have respectively 4 and 2 elements, making the 256-element rings nonisomorphic but with identical product fibers all k. For Q=T=q, E_k=1-k t^(k-1)+(k-1)t^k and nonzero product probability asymptotic (1-1/m)(k/q)t^(k-1), with uniform surviving nonzero off-diagonal. Independently enumerated every target of T2(F2) for k=1..5 with exact rational arithmetic, matching the formula; inspected packaged independent prime-field and F4 Frobenius verifiers. Finite checks corroborate, not replace arbitrary k and bimodule proof.
